catalogue_source: kaggle b t models (46 models listed on 2026-10-12)

kaggle_panel.dataset: FairScreen-48: the first 48 confirmatory core families (6 per occupation), eight decisions each, no controls or repeats
kaggle_panel.rule: The push-validation default model (gemini-3.7-flash) plus one economical model per developer family available on Kaggle with measured or listed cost below 0.001 USD per call. Run cheapest first; stop when the remaining Model Proxy quota falls below 1 USD and report the models not run.
kaggle_panel.settings: provider defaults through the SDK (temperature 0 default, default reasoning)
kaggle_panel.budget_note: Model Proxy quota is 10 USD per day; hosted runs are billed to it (verified 2026-10-12 by reconciling the quota with recorded usage). Each task push triggers one full validation run on the default model.

cluster_panel.dataset: Full confirmatory set: 192 core families with controls and repeats, sufficiency, relevance, realistic and audit suites
cluster_panel.rule: Open-weight instruct models that fit one H200-141 in vLLM, from at least three developers, attempted in this order; models that fail to load are reported, not replaced silently.
cluster_panel.settings: vLLM, temperature 0, chat template of each model, max 4096 new tokens; reasoning models keep their default reasoning
cluster_panel.cross_platform_check: gpt-oss-120b runs on both platforms; its Kaggle score on FairScreen-48 is compared with the cluster score on the same 48 families

development_models_not_in_panel: claude-sonnet-5 (8 dev families only; cost 11 USD per 2830 calls)
